description: potsherd: index each codex thread as it ends, and say up front what the first index will download.

hooks.command: R="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; command -v potsherd >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ -f "$R/bin/potsherd.js" ] || [ -f "$R/../../packages/cli/bin/potsherd.js" ] || { printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart"},"systemMessage":"potsherd: this plugin found no runnable potsherd, so the SessionEnd hook will NOT index this thread. Install it with  npm i -g potsherd  — see the plugin README."}\n'; exit 0; }; MD="${POTSHERD_DIR:-$HOME/.potsherd}/models"; [ -n "$(find "$MD/Xenova/bge-small-en-v1.5/onnx" -name '*.onnx' -size +1000k 2>/dev/null | head -1)" ] || printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart"},"systemMessage":"potsherd: no embedding model on this machine yet. When this thread ends, the SessionEnd hook runs index --quiet, which downloads one: 33 MB, Xenova/bge-small-en-v1.5, into %s. Once, detached, in the background. index --quiet prints nothing on its own, and SessionEnd cannot show you anything, which is why you are told now instead. To skip it: delete the SessionEnd entry from hooks.json and index by hand with --no-embed."}\n' "$MD"; exit 0

ID=$(sed -n 's/.*"session_id"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1); [ -n "$ID" ] || exit 0; R="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; if command -v potsherd >/dev/null 2>&1; then P=potsherd; A=; elif [ -f "$R/bin/potsherd.js" ]; then P=node; A="$R/bin/potsherd.js"; elif [ -f "$R/../../packages/cli/bin/potsherd.js" ]; then P=node; A="$R/../../packages/cli/bin/potsherd.js"; else exit 0; fi; CFG="${POTSHERD_DIR:-$HOME/.potsherd}/config.json"; if grep -q '"cardOnEnd"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*true' "$CFG" 2>/dev/null; then CARD=1; else CARD=; fi; (trap '' HUP; "$P" ${A:+"$A"} index --session "$ID" --quiet; [ -n "$CARD" ] && "$P" ${A:+"$A"} card "$ID" --quiet --yes) </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 & exit 0
